decisions.reason: The panel-arrangement preference is owned by the Console navigation Requirement and does not alter the shell-style attributes or styling deliverable.
The source concerns Console-shell and application panels, not navigation in the public website header.
The navigation-panel decision does not change provisioning-wizard styling; the same message's separate provisioning statements are already represented independently.
Avoiding opposite-side Console panels does not change the common visual treatment for follow-on or informational website pages.
The source changes navigation-panel arrangement preference but establishes no color, typography, spacing, or other design-token change.
The Console panel arrangement has no necessary effect on website footer content, links, or visual styling.
The panel-arrangement decision does not modify Sign-In page styling; Sign-In statements elsewhere in the message are separate from the source Event.
The source addresses simultaneous Console navigation panels, not landing-page breakpoints or general website responsive behavior.
The Console navigation preference does not change any landing-page visual-design attribute.
The source decision does not affect the website implementation stack, handoff objective, or delivered landing-page package.
